name: Carousel around me
trigger: a list, many examples, 'all my…' moments
prompt: Make a 'carousel around me' effect in HyperFrames: vertical 1080x1920, 3 seconds. Video: [video] from second [start]. Cut me out of the background with `npx hyperframes remove-background` and lay the cutout exactly over the source. 8 cards (4:5) from [images] spin in a ring around me. Ring centre at chest height, slight tilt so it reads as a ring. Cards behind me are hidden by me, cards in front pass over me but never cover the face. In the first 0.6 s the cards fly out from behind me into the ring, then the ring rotates about 110 degrees per second. Darken the background slightly.

fields.label: Uses the photos in your image bank (8 cards, repeated if fewer)

name: Glass card with graph
trigger: a number, progress, growth, result
prompt: Make a 'liquid glass with graph' effect in HyperFrames over [video] from second [start]: 1080x1920, 3 s. In the lower half a glass card 840x470, radius 44: blurred background under it, light edge on top, dark at the bottom, soft shadow. Top-left small label '[LABEL]', right a large percentage counting 23, 48, 76, 92 over 2.2 s in whole numbers. A green graph line with fill climbs with the number, glowing dot at its tip. Above the card, word-by-word captions of my speech timed exactly (transcript).

name: Match cut on one word
trigger: the key word / brand name; a transition between your clips
prompt: Make a match-cut effect in HyperFrames: 1080x1920, 3 s, no video. 16 article pages change with hard cuts every 0.12–0.2 s. On every page the word '[WORD]' sits exactly in the centre on a red-orange highlight; only the text around it changes. Pages differ: typewriter, serif newspaper, grotesque, different paper shades and text sizes. Very close up: lines cropped by the frame edges, more blur further from the centre, light vignette and paper grain. On every cut the camera jolts 6 px and slowly pushes in the whole time. Invent the article texts about [topic], no publication names or figures.

fields.label: Article text (empty: your own words from the video)

name: Pixel words
trigger: a short punchline of 3–4 words
prompt: Make a 'words on a pixel screen' effect in HyperFrames: 1080x1920, 3 s. Almost black background, an RGB sub-pixel grid over everything, as if the camera films a screen up close. Huge white words of the phrase '[PHRASE]' slide right to left, one word in frame at a time. Light glow, red and blue copies of the letters offset 3 px, motion blur. The last word stops in the centre by 1.6 s and flickers slightly until the end. Bold font, the longest word no wider than 890 px.

name: iOS toggles
trigger: steps, pros, a 3-item list
prompt: Make an 'iOS toggles' effect in HyperFrames over [video] from second [start]: 1080x1920, 3 s. A white card like iPhone Settings, centred in the lower half. Three rows: '[LINE 1]', '[LINE 2]', '[LINE 3]', thin dividers. A real iOS switch on the right of each row: track 102x62, white knob with shadow. The card appears in 0.25 s. Switches turn on in turn at 0.3, 0.8 and 1.3 s: the knob overshoots slightly, the track turns green #34C759. Darken the video under the card slightly.

name: Zoom + proof cards
trigger: proof, two numbers, before/after facts
prompt: Make a 'zoom and proof cards' effect in HyperFrames on [video] from second [start]: 1080x1920, 3 s. The camera pushes in smoothly on my face, scale 1 to 1.14; find the face yourself so the push lands on it. White rounded cards land beside the head: first left '[label]', a large orange '[number]', '[note]'. After half a second it leaves and a second card lands right with other '[label]', '[number]', '[note]'. Cards never cover the face. Word-by-word captions under the chin. Use only real numbers.

name: Word behind me
trigger: the one word the clip is about (4–7 letters)
prompt: Make a 'word behind me' effect in HyperFrames: vertical 1080x1920, 3 s. Video: [video] from second [start]. Cut me out with `npx hyperframes remove-background`. Layers in order: room, the huge word '[WORD]', me on top. The word spans the full frame width, about 350 px tall, at the top of my head so my head covers the bottom of the letters. Milky colour, light warm glow. In the first 0.45 s the letters rise one by one from under a mask, then the word slowly drifts up 20 px. Darken the room slightly, clean cutout edges with no halo.

fields.label: Word behind you (4–7 letters reads best)

name: Notifications over my head
trigger: 'my phone blew up', orders, messages, reactions
prompt: Make a 'notification stack' effect in HyperFrames over [video] from second [start]: 1080x1920, 3 s. iPhone-like notifications drop from the top: dark frosted glass, radius 34, app icon on the left, app name and 'now' on top, bold title and one line below. Four notifications at 0.05, 0.4, 0.75 and 1.1 s with texts [app, title, line for each]. Each new one lands on top and springs the older ones down; older ones shrink and darken slightly. The stack sits above the head, never on the face. Draw the icons yourself, no real company logos.

name: Video in a 3D phone
trigger: showing an app, a screen recording, 'look at this'
prompt: Make a 'video in a 3D phone' effect in HyperFrames: 1080x1920, 3 s. Dark warm background with soft orange side light. In the centre a logo-free smartphone drawn in code: rounded body, metal edge, camera cutout. On its screen [video] from second [start]. The phone starts rotated 38 degrees on the vertical axis and 12 on the horizontal; over 0.9 s it turns to face the camera and a glare sweeps the glass. Then it floats up and down 10 px and slowly approaches. A soft shadow under it moves with it.

name: Three offset copies (clones)
trigger: lots of gesturing, 'me, me and me', emphasis
prompt: Make a 'three copies of me' effect in HyperFrames: 1080x1920, 3 s. Three vertical strips of 352 px with dark 12 px gaps. Each holds [video], face centred and slightly larger. Strips are offset in time: left from second [start], middle 0.25 s later, right 0.5 s later. In the first 0.5 s the left strip slides in from the top, the right from the bottom, the middle is already there. Then the strips slowly drift in different directions. At 0.6 s a thin orange line slides under the middle strip.

name: You as a sticker
trigger: a reaction, a fun beat, 'made with…' tag
prompt: Make a 'me as a sticker' effect in HyperFrames on [video] from second [start]: 1080x1920, 3 s. Cut me out with `npx hyperframes remove-background`. At 0.05 s the room goes away, replaced by an orange background [#E8572A] with small dots and a vignette. I become a sticker: white outline about 14 px tight to the silhouette and a soft shadow. I 'peel off': shrink to 0.86 and rotate 4 degrees with a bounce, then sway slightly. At 0.5 s a white label with '[TEXT]' appears beside the head.

name: Fly through a letter
trigger: opening transition, the title of the clip
prompt: Make a 'fly through a letter' effect in HyperFrames: 1080x1920, 3 s. Black frame, a huge word '[WORD]' full width in the centre. The letters are windows: through them you see [video] from second [start]; around the letters is black. Thin light outline on the letters. The camera accelerates into the thick part of the letter 'A'. In 0.95 s the letter fills the screen and only my video remains. Then the scale settles softly from 1.06 to 1. Smooth letter edges.

name: Pencil outline on an object
trigger: the word that names an object you hold or point at
prompt: On [video] from second [start], when I say '[WORD]', draw a hand-drawn pencil outline around [object] in the frame: graphite texture, slightly wobbly line drawn on over 0.5 s, small arrow and handwritten label '[WORD]'. Track the object if it moves. Keep it 1.5 s, then erase.

name: Image on the word that names it
trigger: every noun that has a matching photo
prompt: When I say '[WORD]', pop the matching image from [images] next to my head (never on the face) with a white 6 px frame, slight tilt and a spring. Hold it while the word and the next 2–3 words are spoken, then slide it out.

name: Handwriting on the word
trigger: a key word to underline, circle or annotate
prompt: When I say '[WORD]', write it by hand on screen in [handwriting font] stroke by stroke over 0.4 s, with a scribbled underline or circle, in [ink colour]. Place it in empty space, never on the face.

name: Green-screen cutout (any background)
trigger: 'imagine I'm in…', location jokes, swapping the room
prompt: Cut me out of [video] from second [start] with `npx hyperframes remove-background` and place me over [background], matching light and adding a soft contact shadow.

fields.label: Background: photo number in your bank (1 = first)

name: Freeze-frame + punch
trigger: the punchline, a reaction, 'wait for it', the moment to remember
prompt: White flash 0.14 s, the frame freezes and pushes in 1.0 → 1.12, colour drops to 45 %, corner brackets and a label chip; lets go at 2.4 s.

name: Masked title rise
trigger: the hook, a chapter title, the payoff word
prompt: Italic serif setup line, then a huge condensed payoff word; each word rises from 135 % inside its own mask in 0.32 s, shrinking stagger.

name: VHS glitch
trigger: a throwback, 'back in the day', a plot twist, a chaotic beat
prompt: Red and blue split, scanlines, moving noise, tracking wobble and a short roll at the start, for 3 s.

name: Thrown-in title
trigger: the opening line, the topic of the video
prompt: Title thrown in from the top-right corner, lands at chest height; a small yellow line wipes in under it; three spark strokes pop at its corner.

fields.label: Small yellow line under it (empty: words 3+ of the text)

name: Stacked words behind me
trigger: a 2–6 word statement you want to land word by word
prompt: One huge word per line, stacked around the head, each popping in when said, one word yellow; I stay in front.

name: Text I move under
trigger: when you duck, walk or lean into the frame
prompt: A tight three-line block hangs at head height; I move under and through it, my body covers the letters.

name: Written by my finger
trigger: when you point or 'write' in the air
prompt: Yellow handwriting appears letter by letter near the raised hand, in two lines.

name: Pulled out of the screen
needs: a laptop or phone in shot
trigger: when you hold a laptop or phone and 'pull' something out
prompt: The text sits small on the screen (black tilted label, yellow), then flies up and grows into a big yellow title.

fields.label: Where the screen is: left, middle or right

name: Me between the words
trigger: standing or walking with room on both sides
prompt: The text splits into two columns, one on each side of me at chest height; I stand between them in front.

name: Open-hand reveal
trigger: when your hands open apart, one up and one down
prompt: Yellow text revealed between the hands, growing from the middle line outward.

name: Swipe out
trigger: a closing line you swipe away
prompt: The text pops out of the hand, jumps to the top-left, holds, then slides out of frame with a skew and blur.

name: Statement stack
trigger: the 3–6 key phrases of a clip
prompt: 2–4 tight staggered lines, heavy sans + an italic serif last line, white glow; each word blurs in when said.
source: Editing Beast style Clean White (STYLE.md v1, approved 17 Nov 2026)

fields.label: Blur the background while it builds (yes / no)

name: Clean-white card
trigger: an intro or name card, a shaky part of the take
prompt: The clip shrinks into a rounded card on brushed silver with a magenta glow; a small statement inside.
source: Editing Beast style Clean White (STYLE.md v1, approved 17 Nov 2026)

fields.label: Italic serif word under it (empty: the last word)

name: Light leak
trigger: a cut between two thoughts (max 3 per 15 s)
prompt: A cool (mint → lavender) or warm (yellow → red) leak sweeps across, or a white flash; punch-in under it.
source: Editing Beast style Clean White (STYLE.md v1, approved 17 Nov 2026)

name: Silver title card
trigger: the opening question or the closing line (bookend)
prompt: Brand-colour words fly in on silver, sizes jump, one script word; the speaker grows out of a rounded card.
source: Editing Beast style Cinema Lexicon (STYLE.md v1, approved 17 Nov 2026)

name: Hanging key word
trigger: 1 word in 4: the stressed or shouted word
prompt: The key word big (italic or CAPS), the small connector words hang off its corners; hard cuts on the words.
source: Editing Beast style Cinema Lexicon (STYLE.md v1, approved 17 Nov 2026)

name: Choice buttons
trigger: 'this or that' moments
prompt: Two outlined pills with 'or' between; the chosen one fills with the brand colour.
source: Editing Beast style Cinema Lexicon (STYLE.md v1, approved 17 Nov 2026)

name: Neon key word
trigger: a claim, number, problem or result
prompt: The room goes dark in one neon colour, a small lead-in builds, the key word slams in (Anton, skewed, glowing).
source: Editing Beast style Neon Dimension (STYLE.md v1, approved 17 Nov 2026)

fields.label: Neon: green (money, yes), red (problem), cyan (calm, tech), purple (AI, game), pink, gold

name: Neon pill
trigger: the CTA or one stressed word per ~10 s
prompt: An outlined neon pill with skewed white caps at chest height, glow breathing.
source: Editing Beast style Neon Dimension (STYLE.md v1, approved 17 Nov 2026)

name: Light burn
trigger: every presenter ↔ world change
prompt: White light burn with warm edges, then the shot zoom-blurs in; or a 4-frame glitch.
source: Editing Beast style Neon Dimension (STYLE.md v1, approved 17 Nov 2026)

name: Wavy sparkle hook
trigger: the opening question (first 3–5 s)
prompt: Bubbly rounded title (Coiny, white, thick dark-green outline) on the chest; letters pop in one by one, then float on a wave; 10 sparkles twinkle.
source: Meme Chaos (Alina's dumb-scale edit, 17 Nov 2026; STYLE.md draft 18 Nov 2026)

fields.label: Hook text ("/" = line break; empty: the words you selected)
fields.placeholder: who's the dumbest / in our office?

name: Explosion
trigger: the first big move or reveal (one per video)
prompt: A green-screen fire ring (Pixabay, no watermark) bursts around the face + white flash + shake + punch zoom. Add the explosion sound.
source: Meme Chaos (Alina's dumb-scale edit, 17 Nov 2026; STYLE.md draft 18 Nov 2026)

fields.label: Starts at (s into the 3 s piece)
Fire size (1.25 = as in the dumb-scale edit)

name: Disco lights
trigger: a dance move, a pose, a 'party' moment
prompt: A disco ball drops in, six colour beams sweep, colour spots wander, the room dims and flickers. Add the disco beat.
source: Meme Chaos (Alina's dumb-scale edit, 17 Nov 2026; STYLE.md draft 18 Nov 2026)

fields.label: Starts at (s into the 3 s piece)

name: Green-screen background
needs: a file attached in the chat bar
trigger: any moment you want somewhere else behind you
prompt: The room behind the person is replaced by the photo or video attached in the chat bar (the last one, or the one named in the field); the person stays in front (cutout).
source: Meme Chaos (Alina's dumb-scale edit, 17 Nov 2026; STYLE.md draft 18 Nov 2026)

fields.label: Background file (empty: the last photo or video you attached in the chat bar)
Video background starts at (s into it)
Starts at (s into the 3 s piece)

name: Green-screen meme pop
trigger: claps, cheering, a reaction beat
prompt: A keyed green-screen meme clip (e.g. the clapping cat) pops in beside the person, plays, pops out.
source: Meme Chaos (Alina's dumb-scale edit, 17 Nov 2026; STYLE.md draft 18 Nov 2026)

fields.label: Green-screen clip (attach a green-screen video in the chat bar and ask Claude to add it; then type its name here)
Starts at (s into the 3 s piece)

name: Big-face warp
trigger: a group pose, a silly face, the ending
prompt: Every face swells into a big-nose fisheye face for ~1.9 s.
source: Meme Chaos (Alina's dumb-scale edit, 17 Nov 2026; STYLE.md draft 18 Nov 2026)

fields.label: Starts at (s into the 3 s piece)

name: Clap zoom pulse
trigger: people clapping, a beat drop, any rhythm
prompt: On every clap the picture jumps in to 1.07 and settles back in 0.2 s; claps found in the sound.
source: Meme Chaos (Alina's dumb-scale edit, 17 Nov 2026; STYLE.md draft 18 Nov 2026)

fields.label: Clap times (s, empty: found in the sound)

name: Crash line + logo
trigger: 'it's going down', a fall, a loss, a fail
prompt: A logo badge pops at the raised hand, then a red stock-crash zigzag draws down and off screen, the badge riding its tip.
source: Meme Chaos (Alina's dumb-scale edit, 17 Nov 2026; STYLE.md draft 18 Nov 2026)

fields.label: Badge text if the image bank has no logo
Falls to the left or right
Start x (px; empty: the raised hand)
Starts at (s into the 3 s piece)

name: Brand open card
trigger: the first call to action or claim (first 4 s)
prompt: The brand's cream card: a script word in the accent colour, small words, the object in huge caps fly in one by one; the app's phone rises tilted, its buttons and icon pop; all whip off left with blur.
source: Cinema Lexicon v6 (Alina's approved CL01 edit, 17 Nov 2026; Editing Beast STYLE.md §10)

name: App buttons drop
trigger: the product's categories, menu, filters
prompt: The take goes soft-blurred; the app's real buttons (same colours, black outline, offset shadow, icons) fall one by one and bounce into a pile.
source: Cinema Lexicon v6 (Alina's approved CL01 edit, 17 Nov 2026; Editing Beast STYLE.md §10)

name: App button pops
trigger: a button of the product is named or tapped
prompt: That button, in its own colours, springs in tilted high in the frame and leaves before the cut. Click + pop.
source: Cinema Lexicon v6 (Alina's approved CL01 edit, 17 Nov 2026; Editing Beast STYLE.md §10)

fields.label: Button (a button of the brand kit)

name: Swipe chip
trigger: 'swipe left / right'
prompt: A round chip (✕ red or ♥ brand colour) flies off the frame in the swipe direction.
source: Cinema Lexicon v6 (Alina's approved CL01 edit, 17 Nov 2026; Editing Beast STYLE.md §10)

name: Giant number
trigger: a number with its unit ('10 minutes', '3 steps', '50%')
prompt: Cream card: a small lead-in, the number huge in the accent colour sliding in from the right with motion blur, the unit under it.
source: Cinema Lexicon v6 (Alina's approved CL01 edit, 17 Nov 2026; Editing Beast STYLE.md §10)

name: App screen in a phone
needs: brand kit with a screen video or screenshot
trigger: 'look how many options', scrolling, browsing the product
prompt: The official screen recording in a black phone frame on the brand's cream card, three app buttons popping around it.
source: Cinema Lexicon v6 (Alina's approved CL01 edit, 17 Nov 2026; Editing Beast STYLE.md §10)

name: Brand close card
trigger: the last line of an ad (not for interviews or opinion pieces)
prompt: The take shrinks into a rounded card on cream; app icon + name on top, chat bubbles pop around it, the slogan fades in; the last frame is held.
source: Cinema Lexicon v6 (Alina's approved CL01 edit, 17 Nov 2026; Editing Beast STYLE.md §10)

fields.label: Name next to the icon (empty: the brand's)
